description: This file defines the InterviewAttachmentDecorator class, which provides additional functionalities for the InterviewAttachment entity, including retrieving file content and associating an interview by ID within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that extends the functionality of InterviewAttachment entity, enabling retrieval of file content and setting associated interview by ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an InterviewAttachment entity.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the file content from the InterviewAttachment, handling string and resource types.

methods.name: setInterviewById
methods.description: Sets the interview for the attachment using an interview ID by referencing the Interview entity.
